original_test_intent: Verify the Mellanox BlueField-3 cable assembly is mechanically serviceable and correctly seated and that its mapped DPU/host/network path fully recovers after the approved disconnect/reconnect cycle.
original_method: Record BF3/DPU identity, cable part/serial, endpoint/port and host/DPU/link baseline; inspect connector/latch/routing; set the exact vendor-approved powered or unpowered service state; qualified ESD operator performs one release/removal/reinsert cycle; photograph latch/seating; after settle, validate BF3 PCIe/DPU enumeration, management/representor/network ports, negotiated link and error counters/logs.
manual_activity: Qualified operator services the exact BF3 cable and documents seating; agent may collect host/DPU/link evidence.
required_inputs: BF3/DPU, cable part/serial and endpoint/port map
Objective seating/damage/routing criteria, cycle count and settle timeout
Expected PCIe/DPU/management/network identity, link and error thresholds
safety_requirements: Use ESD controls and required quiesce/power state
Stop on pin/shell/latch damage, misalignment or excessive force
Protect BF3 management/host traffic and keep recovery access
Do not repeat insertion to recover or erase diagnostic baselines
agent_execution_scope: Collect BF3 host/DPU enumeration, interfaces, link and counters before/after
Correlate physical photos and service timestamps
Do not handle cable, approve hot service, infer seating only from software, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mechanical acceptance and number of cycles
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Remote tools cannot assess connector damage, latch engagement or handling force; they only verify the BF3 path after service.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Compare BF3 PCIe/DPU identity, management/representor/network interfaces, negotiated link and errors around the operator cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Plug/unplug ease, proper seating and error-free redetection remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pair endpoint-specific physical inspection with both host and DPU-plane recovery evidence after one controlled cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds BF3 management/data-plane identity and objective connector/service controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host enumeration can recover while the DPU management or network data path remains absent or degraded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BF3 has multiple host/DPU/network planes; unsupported live removal may disrupt control and data paths or damage high-speed contacts.

project_override_considerations: If the named cable carries auxiliary power or sideband signals as well as data, the service state and validation matrix must cover those functions explicitly.
expected_evidence: Approved service state and cycle timeline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently covers BF3 cable plug cycling, proper seating and error-free redetection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: It remains valid manual work once the BF3 service procedure and operator are available.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2270 Wistron-HW-00026-V003: approve BF3/DPU identity, cable part/serial and endpoint/port/sideband map; vendor latch/insertion/removal and supported powered/hot-plug versus powered-down procedure, cycle count, force/seating/damage/routing criteria and settle time; define host PCIe, DPU management/representor/network interface, negotiated link and error/log recovery matrix plus final state.

review_improvement: Preserves the BF3 physical plug-cycle coverage while ensuring both host and DPU planes, not just generic detection, recover correctly.
independent_technical_reasoning: BlueField-3 exposes a DPU with host PCIe and separate management/network functions, so generic 'device detected' can miss a failed control or data plane. Mechanical acceptance also cannot be inferred from enumeration: a partially latched high-speed connector can train intermittently or at reduced capability. Exact endpoint mapping, qualified service state, physical evidence and host/DPU/link/error comparison are all needed after the single controlled cycle.
